import sys,re,json,subprocess,datetime
sys.path.insert(0,'/private/tmp/world365-m1-continuation-wkh0chmf')
import audit as a
C,L,D,A,I=a.OWNED
base={p:a.basebytes(p) for p in a.OWNED}; live={p:a.read(p) for p in a.OWNED}
pattern=rb'^## STATUS \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \xe2\x80\x94 ITERATION (\d+):[^\n]*\n\n'
stamps=list(re.finditer(pattern,base[C],re.M)); assert [m[1] for m in stamps]==[b'364',b'363',b'362']
pair=stamps[2][0]
line='## STATUS 2026-11-07 — ITERATION 365: ADMIN record only; row 256 PARKED needs-human-review, independent MiniMax FAIL 85, LOCAL_CRITERION UNMET, draft PR #515. D-WORLD-105/110/111/112 remain OPEN; D111 and D112 are independent human gates. No autonomous skip257/201/243 or product acceptance. Evidence: verification/world-iter365/; full log entry 365.\n\n'.encode()
p=stamps[0].start(); expected_c=(base[C][:p]+line+base[C][p:]).replace(pair,b'',1).replace(b'Current route (iteration 364)',b'Current route (iteration 365)',1)
row=b'| 365 | 2026-11-07 | ADMIN record only; row 256 remains parked [ADMIN] |\n'
p=re.search(rb'^\| 364 \|',base[I],re.M).start(); expected_i=base[I][:p]+row+base[I][p:]
heading='## 365 — 2026-11-07 — ADMIN record only; row 256 remains parked [ADMIN]'.encode()
ledger_pat=rb'<!-- decision-ledger:start -->\n.*?<!-- decision-ledger:end -->\n'
def charter_guard(b):
 assert b==expected_c,'whole charter expected-byte comparison'
 assert re.findall(pattern,b,re.M)==[b'365',b'364',b'363'],'dated STATUS identity/order'
 assert b.count(b'Current route (iteration 365)')==1 and b.count(b'Current route (iteration 364)')==0,'route token uniqueness'
 assert b.count(b'\n')==6345,'charter lines'
 ledger=re.search(ledger_pat,b,re.S).group(); queue=b[b.index(b'## Queue (top = next;'):]
 assert ledger==re.search(ledger_pat,base[C],re.S).group(),'whole marked ledger bytes'
 assert a.sha(ledger)=='58853d5b3207b3cbcdc4d16c69616babc90534a92cad71f621f0b931a6bc8f01','whole marked ledger SHA256'
 assert len(re.findall(rb'^\| D-WORLD-[^|]+\|',ledger,re.M))==99,'ledger99'
 assert queue==base[C][base[C].index(b'## Queue (top = next;'):],'queue suffix bytes'
 assert a.sha(queue)=='f51d5ac1b9a8026e3ec4feb5a7dd5344cb77483c9837a23b2a64867f652190e4','queue SHA256'
 for n in [105,110,111,112]:
  assert len(re.findall(rb'^\| D-WORLD-'+str(n).encode()+rb' \| OPEN \|',ledger,re.M))==1,'OPEN decision'
def archive_guard(b):
 assert b==base[A]+pair,'whole archive expected pair and prefix comparison'
 assert b.startswith(base[A]),'old archive prefix'
 assert a.sha(b[len(base[A]):])=='27fecc13ef71fc8811f1c426b134c9650c57d86a3399446aa5ccf5c37d5ab260','362 pair SHA256'
 assert b.count(b'\n')==730,'archive lines'
 prior359=re.findall(rb'^## STATUS \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \xe2\x80\x94 ITERATION 359:[^\n]*\n\n',base[A],re.M)
 assert len(prior359)==1 and b.count(prior359[0])==1,'prior359 exact retained'
def log_guard(b):
 assert b.startswith(base[L]),'entire prior log byte prefix comparison'
 assert len(re.findall(rb'^## \d+ \xe2\x80\x94 \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \xe2\x80\x94 ',b,re.M))==39,'canonical log count39'
 assert b.count(heading)==1,'canonical365 heading identity'
 assert len(re.findall(rb'^## 365 \xe2\x80\x94 ',b,re.M))==1,'only one365'
 assert not re.search(rb'^## 361 \xe2\x80\x94 ',b,re.M),'no invented canonical361'
 routing=b'**Routing evidence:** base='+a.BASE.encode()+b'@2026-11-07T16:58:29Z;'
 assert b[len(base[L]):].count(routing)==1,'canonical routing evidence'
 note=json.loads((a.SESSION/'prepared.json').read_text())['driver_note_verbatim'].encode()
 assert b[len(base[L]):].count(note)==1,'verbatim driver note'
def index_guard(b):
 assert b==expected_i,'entire index expected-byte comparison'
 assert b.count(row)==1,'exact365 row'
 orphan=re.findall(rb'^\| 361 \|[^\n]*\n',base[I],re.M)
 assert len(orphan)==1 and b.count(orphan[0])==1,'orphan361 exact'
def dashboard_guard(b):
 assert 0<len(b.splitlines())<=40,'dashboard <=40 lines'
 for token in ['PARKED','FAIL85','UNMET','D105','D110','D111','D112','independently','250 →255 →256 →257 →201 →243','inherited','173284','pending','goal unmoved','no automatic product pick']:
  assert token.encode() in b,'required dashboard token '+token
def protected_guard(b):
 actual=a.run(['git','hash-object','--stdin'],b).decode().strip()
 expected=a.run(['git','rev-parse',a.BASE+':CLAUDE.md']).decode().strip()
 assert actual==expected,'protected Git blob comparison'
frozen=json.loads((a.SESSION/'session.json').read_text())['frozen_inputs']
def input_guard(actual):
 assert actual==frozen,'explicit frozen-input hash/type/mode comparison'
positive=[]
for name,fn,data in [('charter',charter_guard,live[C]),('archive',archive_guard,live[A]),('log',log_guard,live[L]),('index',index_guard,live[I]),('dashboard',dashboard_guard,live[D]),('protected-byte',protected_guard,a.read('CLAUDE.md')),('frozen-inputs',input_guard,a.frozen_check())]:
 fn(data);positive.append({'guard':name,'rc':0})
controls=[]
def negative(name,fn,data,mutation):
 try: fn(data)
 except AssertionError as e: controls.append({'name':name,'mutation':mutation,'detected':True,'guard_rejection':str(e),'rc':1})
 else: controls.append({'name':name,'mutation':mutation,'detected':False,'guard_rejection':None,'rc':0})
protected=a.read('CLAUDE.md'); negative('protected-byte',protected_guard,bytes([protected[0]^1])+protected[1:],'flip one byte of actual protected CLAUDE.md in memory, use git hash-object --stdin without -w')
negative('duplicate365',charter_guard,live[C].replace(line,line+line,1),'duplicate the actual365 STATUS pair in memory')
stamp363=re.search(rb'^## STATUS \d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2} \xe2\x80\x94 ITERATION 363:[^\n]*\n\n',live[C],re.M)[0]
negative('drop363',charter_guard,live[C].replace(stamp363,b'',1),'remove actual363 STATUS pair in memory')
mutpair=bytes([pair[0]^1])+pair[1:]
negative('corrupt362-pair',archive_guard,live[A][:-len(pair)]+mutpair,'flip first byte of appended362 pair in memory, preserving old archive prefix')
negative('other-route-byte',charter_guard,live[C].replace(b'Current route (iteration 365): ADMIN',b'Current route (iteration 365): aDMIN',1),'change ADMIN byte outside the permitted route token substitution')
negative('prior-log-byte',log_guard,live[L][1:],'delete first byte of actual retained log prefix in memory')
orphan=re.search(rb'^\| 361 \|[^\n]*\n',live[I],re.M)[0]
negative('orphan361',index_guard,live[I].replace(orphan,orphan.replace(b'orphan:',b'ORPHAN:',1),1),'change orphan361 prior row in memory')
negative('dashboard-over40',dashboard_guard,live[D]+b'overflow\n'*(41-len(live[D].splitlines())),'append in-memory lines to exactly41')
mut=json.loads(json.dumps(frozen)); key=a.DIR+'record-plan.md'; mut[key]['sha256']='0'*64
negative('frozen-input-hash',input_guard,mut,'change ready plan SHA256 in an in-memory actual-input hash map')
assert len(controls)==9 and all(c['detected'] for c in controls),controls
# Actual tracked checks; untracked files get explicit no-index checks at final publication.
whitespace=[]
for argv in [['git','diff','--check'],['git','diff','--check',a.BASE,'--']]:
 p=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=a.ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True)
 whitespace.append({'argv':argv,'rc':p.returncode,'stdout':p.stdout,'stderr':p.stderr}); assert p.returncode==0,whitespace[-1]
result={'at_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'structural_checks_rc':0,'positive_controls':positive,'negative_controls':controls,'negative_summary':{'attempted':len(controls),'detected':sum(c['detected'] for c in controls),'survivors':sum(not c['detected'] for c in controls)},'counts':{'charter_lines':len(live[C].splitlines()),'archive_lines':len(live[A].splitlines()),'dashboard_lines':len(live[D].splitlines()),'canonical_log_entries':39,'active_statuses':[365,364,363],'ledger_rows':99,'index_added_rows':1},'preservation_sha256':{'marked_ledger':a.sha(re.search(ledger_pat,live[C],re.S).group()),'queue_suffix':a.sha(live[C][live[C].index(b'## Queue (top = next;'):]),'status362_pair':a.sha(pair),'base_log_prefix':a.sha(live[L][:len(base[L])]),'base_archive_prefix':a.sha(live[A][:len(base[A])])},'record_hashes':{p:{'sha256':a.sha(b),'bytes':len(b),'mode':oct((a.ROOT/p).stat().st_mode&0o777)} for p,b in live.items()},'tracked_whitespace':whitespace,'commands':a.commands}
(a.SESSION/'structural.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'structural_checks_rc':0,'positive_controls':len(positive),'negative_controls':result['negative_summary'],'counts':result['counts'],'tracked_whitespace_rc':[v['rc'] for v in whitespace]},indent=2))
